- **Depends on:** 095
- **Story:** As Riley, I want C# twins of the two fix development tasks (010, 011) and a check that all eight twins match the Phrase suite, so that I can trust the plain-C# suite covers exactly the tasks the Phrase suite covers before any baseline run is paid for.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given tasks 010 and 011, When the C# suite is listed, Then each has a C# prompt with a failing C# starting program and an xUnit outcome check equivalent to its Phrase twin
  2. Given bench/suite.json and the C# suite, When the completeness check runs, Then every non-holdout task id has exactly one C# twin with the same kind and the same outcome cases, and there is no C# task without a Phrase twin (the check fails on a missing or extra task)
  3. Given the sealed holdout hashes, When the suite is built, Then no holdout body is read and no holdout twin exists yet (twins for the holdouts are made at unsealing, card 088)
